title: Sculptalicious Meredith
author: Jaskirat
desc:
Welcome to Sculptalicious Meredith — she’s not just a workout plan, she’s a whole vibe. This 4-day program is designed to help you sculpt strong curves, fire up your confidence, and channel main character energy every time you train. We’re talking glute-focused workouts, fat-burning moves, and that bold, fearless energy... just like Meredith (you know the one 😉). No drama, just dumbbells and dedication. 🍑💪

Designed by – Jas

ex.note:
Goal: Glute activation.
Use a band if available. 
Banded bridges, clams

Can substitute this with Dumbbell squats
RPE: Rate of Perceived Exertion

Reps are per leg
3x10 means 3 sets 10 reps per leg which means 20 reps in one set for both legs
In first two weeks do bodyweight then add dumbbells in later week

LISS -> Low Intensity Steady State Cardio. 
Walk speed: 5.5-6 kmph or 3 mph.
Incline: 8-12, increase incline by 0.5% in every session whilst keeping same time

ss.note: Alternate: Dumbbell thruster (preferred)

start with body weight
12 reps per leg

ex.note: Alternate: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
Alternate: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
Reps are per leg

ss.note:
6A-6B is a superset.
Do 30s sprint/rope followed by a 90s walk.

Repeat this combination for 6-7 rounds
